title: Romualdez to seek bail as Sandiganbayan weighs suspension

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez will seek bail in the P7.44-billion plunder case filed against him, his lawyers told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Wednesday. Romualdez, wearing a yellow shirt issued to persons deprived of liberty and seated in a wheelchair, attended his arraignment via video conference from the New Quezon City Jail-Male Dormitory. He pleaded not guilty to the charge. Associate Justice Karl Miranda, chair of the Third Division, asked Romualdez’s lawyers whether he intended to seek bail after entering his plea.
